scope: Proposition 17.4 (Finite resampling and multiplicative comparison) of the manuscript “The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order” (preprints/The-hypercube-Ramsey-number-has-linear-order-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 171 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7d4b26e897038267), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 144. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix, before drawing tapes, a deterministic restricted event set, a defining event Sv in that set, and a deterministic set of at most n10(Ac+10) target cells. Suppose the pools are individually typical and satisfy (17.1) for every event tested in the restricted simulation. All conclusions below concern that restricted process. The defining event’s final failure probability is at most n−PTs/2. The probability of more than Ts executions in the backward closure of the target cells is also at most n−PTs/2. For every nonnegative test of those target states, the final-state expectation is at most 1 + o(1) times its independent fresh-cell expectation at the same fixed pools.
